name: Toudou Shino
source:
Shino is a typical high-handed upper class girl. Her family own an Aikido dojo and Shino considers herself to be the school's queen. Once [url=/c94458]Yamanami Michiru[/url] had transferred, Shino sees her as a rival, so the battle between the two top girls who heats up. 

[Translated from Ragna Archives and Side Story.]
